checkpointPayload.description:
User feedback 2026-11-01, after the foil shipped (MO-VWFTGZ): the current B50 card on /scores doesn't suit the holo well. That card is a 160px full-bleed jacket background with a dark gradient and a 2.5px difficulty border (app/scores/scores-client.tsx B50Card). The user paused before redesigning it.

The foil tryout used a different card: jacket thumbnail on the left, title, difficulty + rank glyphs, achievement, rating on the right, on a solid surface (https://claude.ai/artifact/QUrEk48Zp5heAHi9gYLk2J). Explore card designs that let the foil edge, band and tint read clearly. Tie this to the pending web palette decision (comparison: https://claude.ai/artifact/UdJGQtpbFCQmpvCDvodeVu).
checkpointPayload.title: Web: redesign the B50 card so it suits the holo foil
